name: Passkey MFA Token Endpoint
summary: Maps password-challenge-bound Passkey MFA completion to the shared Passkey MFA proof service and establishes a mobile token session only after the challenge-bound Passkey proof succeeds.

sourceReferences.note: The anonymous mobile completion endpoint delegates challenge-bound proof to IPasskeyMfaAuthenticationService and mints the token session only after a proven AppUser is returned.
